collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HONESTY AND ACCOUNTABILITY (HON-01 to HON-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Small lies, kind fibs, things left unsaid, things forgotten, honest mistakes and the odd careless one. Consequences stay the size of the mistake. Privacy is not lying, truth doesn't automatically fix things, and nobody has to confess, apologize or forgive.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A friend asks if a villager ate the last honey cake, and the villager says they ate a cake: hold firm, or give in.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There was one honey cake left in the basket this morning. Now there are none. (friend) asks (subject), "Did you eat the last cake?" (subject), who ate a cake, which happened to be the last one, says very carefully, "I ate A cake."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "...It was the last one," (subject) admits. "I'm sorry. It was looking at me." (friend) sighs. "I was saving it." "I know. That's why it was looking at me." (friend) makes (subject.him/her) promise to save the last one next time. (subject) does, and has to look at it all day.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "Was it the last one?" "It was a cake that was in the basket." "Was there any other cake in the basket?" "...Not after I ate it." (friend) shakes (friend.his/her) head and laughs in spite of (friend.him/her)self. "That's the most honest lie I've ever heard." (subject) bakes the next batch.
